title: Mixed Event — Let's Enjoy Together! SpoJoy Park — Episode3 Everyone, To SpoJoy Park!

meta.Event Outline: Kanade's fatigue has been catching up to her as of late. Worried that it might affect her compositions, she decides to put effort into building her stamina alongside Ena. They hear that a new sports facility called SpoJoy Park just opened near the station...

rows.Line: Outside the station

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wow...!
The way Ichika sings is always so cool...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Is she your friend, Minori?
She does seem like the cool type.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! She's cool, collected and really mature, but also super nice!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: She's even in a band with her childhood friends and they're all trying to go pro together!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, really?
That explains why she's so good.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hoshino's singing voice is so gentle... But also feels so powerful...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, Kanade, you know her?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, I do.
Remember when I borrowed that Miku CD from someone? That was Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
That was her...?!
Then, she's Mafuyu's junior, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Whoa...!
Kanade, I didn't know you were friends with Ichika...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Seeing that I know the friends of my friends is kinda perplexing, but also makes me really happy.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Friends...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(Are we...friends?
We just talked about music...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you all for listening!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Ichika, that was great!
You were so amazing just now!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Minori, you stopped by to listen... Hm? Wait, isn't that...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Y-Yoisaki...?!
What are you doing here...?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I'm here with Hanasato.
I really liked your song.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you...
I'm glad to hear that but also a little embarrassed...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yoisaki, I was so surprised to hear that you knew Minori... Oh, but I don't think I've met your friend here... Um...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I'm Ichika Hoshino.
It's nice to meet you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm Ena Shinonome.
Nice to meet you. I draw illustrations for the music group Kanade and I are in.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
For your music group...?
Then, Shinonome, you drew all that artwork...?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I saw you guys' music video the other day and really loved the illustrations! I thought it was wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? R-Really?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes! I almost couldn't believe how well it captured the song's theme! It was really incredible!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Well, it's really nothing special...
But it's nice to hear you say that since I do put a lot of thought into my art.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm glad for you, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: By the way, what are you all doing here together...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: After some discussion, we all decided to head over to SpoJoy Park together to work on building our stamina!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hanasato saved us by suggesting to try it out since exercising outside isn't exactly easy right now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. Let's all break a good sweat, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Kanade...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Minori, I didn't realize that you and Yoisaki were so close. You calling her Kanade sort of startled me a little.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, I thought the same thing just now. Is it because you helped her out the other day?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? But we're the same age...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
The same age?
Aren't you a year younger than Airi?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What? I mean, yes...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But Kanade's...
Wait, are we not?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I don't know much about Airi, but I'm the same age as Ena...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Right.
Which means you're a year older than Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-That means I've been getting the wrong idea this entire time...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry!!
Kanade... Wait, no! I mean... You're so tiny and adorable that I just assumed we're around the same age!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's okay, really. I don't mind.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And you don't have to be formal at all with me. Call me what you're comfortable with.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Really...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, you don't have to be formal with us. I mean, we're not at school, so let's just talk without caring about how old we all are.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you...!
Kanade! Ena!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Great. Right back at you, Minori, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Um... Ena... Kanade...
It'll be my honor to...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hm? What happened to not being so formal?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I-I'm sorry.
It's just... I'm not very used to these sorts of situations, so I can't help but talk like that...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Hehe. Don't worry.
It's okay to just be yourself.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, I almost forgot.
You were all about to head over to SpoJoy Park, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, we were! Hey, Ichika, why don't you come with us?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, me?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! The more the merrier, right?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (SpoJoy Park, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, singing isn't just about the physical act of singing. You need good stamina and a high lung capacity to be able to project your voice to the back of big live houses.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (And I want to talk more with both of them...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I don't mind... What do you say, Ichika?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, um...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If you two are okay with it, I'd like to join you...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'd like that as well.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, sounds good. Let's all go together.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Woohoo!
Here we come SpoJoy Park!
SpoJoy Park

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Here we are... We have arrived at SpoJoy Park!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's so cool...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It is nice. It's hard to believe that it's so hot out, and we won't have to worry about getting heat stroke while we're here.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wow, you really can play all sorts of different sports... They've got basketball and tennis courts...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, you can play futsal on the rooftop!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
They even have that...?
This place really does sound like fun.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm glad we learned about this place, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Me too.
Thank you, Hanasato.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. You're very welcome!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Look!
They have an arcade over there!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? Isn't this supposed to be a sports facility?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Maybe it's because they get a lot of kids here.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wait...!
That claw machine has PenPyon plushies!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: They're so popular because of how cute they are... They'd look great in a selfie too, so I kinda want one...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: PenPyon...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait, yeah! It's PenPyon!
Haruka's really into that character right now, so maybe she'd like it if I got her one...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Mind if I give it a quick go...?
I'll be right back!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-I'm gonna give it a try too...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
W-Wait, what happened to exercising...?!
There they go...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Is PenPyon really that popular?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I guess so. One of my friends also has a few.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um, I need to use the restroom for a bit. What about you, Kanade...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm okay. I'll wait here, so take your time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay.
I'll be right back.

rows.Speaker: Ena's Voice
rows.Line:
No! It fell again!
Seriously, how weak is this arm?!

rows.Speaker: Minori's Voice
rows.Line: But we almost got it just now, Ena! I'm gonna give it another try!

rows.Speaker: Ena's Voice
rows.Line: Yeah, one or two more and we might actually have it... Alright, once more!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(Hehe...
They seem to be enjoying themselves.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Also...)

rows.Speaker: Boys
rows.Line: Hey, let's play some futsal!

rows.Speaker: Boys
rows.Line:
Yeah!
How should we do teams?

rows.Speaker: Junior High Schoolers
rows.Line:
No, that ball was so going in!
I totally had you that time!

rows.Speaker: Junior High Schoolers
rows.Line: Haha. You can ask for as many rematches as you want, but you're never gonna beat me!

rows.Speaker: Junior High Schoolers
rows.Line: Grr! You're the worst!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Everyone here seems to be having fun.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(What was that?
My chest felt funny for a second just now...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, you've come to another fun-looking place.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Luka...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Aren't you going to join the others, Kanade? All those plushies look so adorable.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I think they're cute too...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
But I'll pass.
I don't usually put plushies or anything in my room...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. I think it's more about the challenge that the game presents, no?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Kanade, thank you for waiting.
Who were you talking to just now?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, um... No one...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay...?
Hang on. They're still at it?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: They've been trying over and over again. They seem adamant about getting a plushie.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, I think they're done.
And they seem awfully sad...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sob*
I couldn't get a PenPyon for Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Honestly, what was with that claw machine?! There's no way that it wasn't rigged!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Haha...
Ena seems really frustrated.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Looks like they're coming back empty-handed.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks for waiting, you two.
Let's change gears and get to exercising!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay.
Why don't we take a look at the pamphlet and decide what we want to do?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Alright, let's start with...
